question: Yamini Krishnamurthy is known for which classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Kuchipudi has a predominace of Shringaara ras.
 
• Kuchipudi involves different foot movements and is generally a team performance.
 
• The central them of Kuchipuri is Bhagavata Puran but is secular in nature.
 
• The dancers of Kuchipuri came to be known as Bhagavathalus.
 
• Yamini Krishnamu
